outcomes.description: Move the mug so that it is positioned to the right of the headphones.
outcomes.target: The mug is visibly positioned to the right of the headphones.
outcomes.reference: The headphones in the image; compare the mug’s position with the headphones.

nodes.question: Does the edited image show the source mug moved to the right of the headphones, rather than merely adding a mug there while the source mug remains at its former position?
nodes.criteria: Compare the source and edited images to identify the source mug and determine whether that mug is now visibly to the right of the headphones. Pass only when the source mug's moved position is supported by the visual evidence; fail when it is clear the source mug was not moved to the right; unknown when object identity, movement, or relative position cannot be determined reliably. Do not treat an additional mug on the right alone as proof that the requested move occurred.
nodes.binding: The mug visible in the source image (blue, left of the headphones) and the headphones in the source and edited images; compare the source mug's identity and position across images.

program.checker_template: Evaluate ONE independent required condition against the SOURCE and EDITED images. No reference label, previous answers or optimization feedback is supplied. Return pass if the condition is satisfied, fail if it is not satisfied, or unknown if the evidence cannot establish an answer. Inspect only this saved condition, its criteria and binding. Report factual evidence and confidence (0..1 or null). A pass means satisfaction of THIS condition, not an overall edit label. Do not anticipate the optimizer's target. Missing evidence or transport/schema failures must not become a negative observation. The final overall label is computed by code; you never supply it.

observations.evidence: The source shows one blue mug to the left of the headphones. In the edited image, a mug is visible to the right of the headphones, but the source mug's former left-side position still has a blue mug-shaped blur, while another mug appears on the right. This supports that a mug was added on the right rather than the source mug being moved there.

findings.source_phrase: Move the mug to the right of the headphones
findings.question: Does the edited image show the original blue mug itself relocated to the right of the headphones, rather than only a different-looking mug placed there?
findings.criteria: Compare the mug’s distinctive blue color and shape in the source with the edited image. Determine whether the right-side mug is visibly the source mug; do not infer identity from position alone.
findings.evidence: The source has a large blue mug left of the headphones. The edited image has a pale, blurred blue shape at the former left position and a white mug to the right; the right-side mug does not visibly retain the source mug’s blue appearance.
findings.rationale: The existing check addresses whether the source mug was moved rather than duplicated, but its observation treats the left blur as evidence of the source mug remaining. A focused identity check would clarify whether the right-side mug is the requested mug or a replacement/addition; appearance differences alone may leave this unresolved.
